# [TASK] Tests and docs: recommendations surface

## Task
Tests and docs for the recommendations surface.

## Scope
Coverage gaps left after Tasks #220/#221's own inline tests.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Component tests cover loading, empty, error, and success states end to end (`Recommendations.test.jsx`: unauthenticated redirect, pre-fetch uninitialized tick, loading spinner, error, empty-history, zero-picks, single result with caption, multi-result per-card hydration, per-card loading)
- [x] RTK Query endpoint test (mocked fetch) covers the request shape sent to ai-service (`AI.test.js`, `aiApi.getMovieRecommendations (#220)`: asserts the exact URL/method/body, plus the query-vs-mutation shape, favorites-error, all-lookups-failed, and partial-failure paths)
- [x] Coverage meets the 80% floor set in `vite.config.mjs` for statements, branches, functions and lines (`npm run test:coverage`, thresholds enforced by Vitest)
- [x] Frontend README/component docs updated for the new `/recommendations` route (`README.md`'s new "Recommendations" section, `FRONTEND_ARCHITECTURE.md`'s directory listing)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 4

## Notes
SonarQube is not configured for the frontend module (no `sonar-project.properties`, no server in this environment). This applies to every frontend Task in this backlog; it is a pre-existing gap, not one this Task introduces.
